experiment_data.hypothesis: AWQ INT4 quantization of fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B does not significantly affect constraint enforcement (DR/CF) on SciERC S1, validating that OntoCoDec is robust to quantization. Expect DR and violation rates comparable to FP16 (DR=0.09%, CF=0.46%), and R-F1 within 1-2pp of FP16 (45.47%).
